notes: Pass 1 only (CWE-022/023/036/073, Path Traversal); Step 3 LLM candidate labeling of extraction/sources.csv (70 rows) + extraction/sinks.csv (269 rows).

Labeling model: glm-5.3 via Claude Code CLI session; every candidate was verified against the real source tree (first-hand reading, no ground-truth artifacts opened: CVE reports / patches / path_traversal_sinks.csv in the source root were NOT consulted).
Batch policy: 13 module-group batches (S1-S6 sources, K1-K7 sinks); batch sizes recorded in labels_raw_pass1.json.

Trust model: nltk is a LIBRARY. Sources are (a) the wordnet browser HTTP request path (the only remote boundary), (b) the downloader's network-controlled XML-index attributes and package zip entry names, and (c) public library-API parameters (the application-facing boundary). os.environ reads and interactive input() are operator trust - labeled none/fp (or candidate where they anchor the vulnerable channel).

No sanitizer entries: no startswith/containment/realpath/basename defense exists anywhere in the labeled flows - normpath (:257) keeps a leading '..', abspath (:331) normalizes without confinement, existence checks neutralize nothing. MySanitizers will resolve to none() in Phase 2.

path_join/path_normalize/path_decode sink candidates are labeled 'summary' (propagation steps) per the Pass-1 rule that join/stat/decode are not dangerous file access by themselves; path_stat candidates are labeled 'none'.
Merged duplicates: rows with identical (file, line, callable, argIndex, role) were merged (net_xml_attr 287x2, 328x2); merge count recorded in label_stats.md.
